discrepancies.title: Unprovisioned Remote Cloud CUDA Endpoint
discrepancies.description: Remote cloud CUDA server is unconfigured in local test harness. Staging worker operates on Apple Silicon M2 MPS.
discrepancies.evidence: HTTP staging worker active on 127.0.0.1:8088 (Apple Silicon M2 MPS). Remote GPU flagged as BLOCKED without credentials.

discrepancies.title: Hardware Button Hole PBR Normal Encoding
discrepancies.description: Individual placket buttonholes and grommet eyelets are rendered via PBR normal/albedo textures rather than individual 3D sub-meshes to conserve WebGL draw calls.
discrepancies.evidence: Classified as TEXTURE_ONLY detail in ComponentRegistry, preserving zero overhead during browser rendering.

certification: Zero blocking discrepancies for production trial deployment.
